name: NOVACYT  EO-,0667
summary: Novacyt S.A. is an international diagnostics business generating an increasing portfolio of in vitro and molecular diagnostic tests, and near-patient point-of-care tests. The company serves a wide range of human and animal diseases and Novacyt's ordinary shares are listed on the London Stock Exchange's AIM market. The company is headquartered in Eastleigh, United Kingdom.
